cc:Work.dc:description: Conceptual five-stage health IT validation pathway: need, mechanism, intervention, benefit and equity, implementation. Proposed research framework, not validated product efficacy or commercial viability.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #151515

g.text: Figure 2. A health IT validation pathway

text.style: font-size: 9.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #151515

g.text: Proposed research framework | Evidence is required at each stage

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #151515
font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #151515

g.text: Define clinically indicated care and unmet need.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #151515

g.text: Use an eligible denominator; include patients who receive no care.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #151515
font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #151515

g.text: Identify where financing or delivery impedes care.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #151515

g.text: Distinguish coverage, cost, authorization, referral and follow-through.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #151515
font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #151515

g.text: Specify the workflow, comparator and causal hypothesis.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #151515

g.text: Separate software effects from staffing, subsidies and other support.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #151515
font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #151515

g.text: Test patient benefit, harms and equitable reach.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #151515

g.text: Prespecify sex comparisons; assess health outcomes beyond process.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #151515
font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #151515

g.text: Verify feasibility, sustained outcomes and a credible buyer.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #151515

g.text: Measure workload, data access, cost and adoption; payment is distinct.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #151515

g.text: Advance, revise or stop according to the evidence.

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #151515

g.text: Average benefit does not establish equity; a coverage code does not establish a market.
